'''Maarten Logghe Big Blue starring Imperial Command''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Maarten Logghe]]
* '''Published:''' August 2000 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Big Blue starring Imperial Command
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Big Blue starring Imperial Command.txt |Download]]
